s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
key_facts: man in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate on skin biopsy
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining

preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement

atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: presence of atypical lymphocytes, nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, and clonal T-cell receptor rearrangements

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: dermal papules, inflammatory arthritis, and mild restrictive lung disease

shortlist.label: Amyopathic dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions and absence of muscle weakness

shortlist.label: Granuloma annulare
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions with nodular to diffuse infiltrate

raw.rationale: The presence of dermal papules with a nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, atypical lymphocytes, and a low CD4 signal with a robust CD8 signal on immunostaining, along with clonal T-cell receptor rearrangements in skin and bone marrow samples, strongly supports this diagnosis

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: The absence of muscle weakness and the specific immunophenotypic features of the lymphocytes do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Amyopathic dermatomyositis
rejected.why: The lack of typical dermatomyositis skin changes and the presence of atypical lymphocytes point away from this diagnosis

rejected.label: Erythema elevatum diutinum
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not align with this condition, which typically presents with purpuric lesions on the extensor surfaces

rejected.label: Granuloma annulare
rejected.why: The histological features and clinical presentation do not match this condition, which typically shows granulomatous inflammation without atypical lymphocytes
